rounds.response:
Each Friday, spend 5 minutes on this simple check‑in and write your answers in your notebook.  
Q1: Did I complete my SMITs this week? If not, note the main reason.  
Q2: How many unplanned “yes”es did I take, and did I use the pause/trade‑off lines when asked?  
Q3: What one concrete change will I make next week to better protect my SMIT (e.g., block focused time, use the scripts, send a follow‑up)?  
Finish by penciling in next Monday’s SMIT and adding a 5‑minute calendar reminder to repeat this check‑in.
